datasets.source_file: TikTok Project Feature Briefing - Feishu Docs.pdf

records.title: Melor
records.feature_overview: Melor is SoundOn's AI-powered tool that creates stunning visual assets for your music, aiming to engage fans on social platforms while clarifying the transition from free to paid features.
records.user_flow: 1. Log in to SoundOn 2. Go to 'Promotion' tab 3. Click 'Auto-generate video' 4. Choose your style and export
records.content_type: Title & Desc, Button, CTA, Tooltip, Dialog, Banner, Empty State, Tab
records.target_audience: This feature is for music creators on SoundOn. It is for users who make visual content and need to understand free vs paid access in Melor.
records.summary: Melor is an AI tool that generates visual assets for music, with a focus on clarifying paid features for users.
records._note: localization_notes removed (bled in from next feature '"Explore" Landing page')

records.title: "Explore" Landing page
records.feature_overview: Prompt users to set home feed to 'Explore'. 'Explore' tab (another name 'Community') is designed for dual-column layout and users with shared interests and discussion points. User can change back to default 'For you' feed also.
records.localization_notes: Keep title and CTA button as concise as possible. Focus on user engagement as we want more users to land on 'Explore'. Use day-to-day expressions. Avoid stiff or wordy languages.
records.summary: The 'Explore' landing page encourages users to engage with shared interests and discussions.

records.title: TikTok GO Central Hub MVP
records.feature_overview: We are building the TikTok GO central hub, a dedicated space within TikTok for local services. This feature aims to provide merchants with a new operational channel and create a destination for users to discover, revisit, and repurchase deals for dining, and other local activities.
records.user_flow: Homepage New user deal Deal entrance and subpage Order entrance and subpage
records.localization_notes:
• Keep calls-to-action (CTAs) like "Claim" and "More deals" concise and compelling.
• The tone should be encouraging and value-focused (e.g., "Welcome offer", "Up to X% off").
• For empty states, ensure the messaging is clear and direct, guiding the user on what to do next (e.g., "No internet connection. Connect to the internet and try again.").
• Translate "Brand Offers" contextually, ensuring they feel natural and exciting in the target language.
• "Flash Sale" is a DNT. Please do not translate it.
records.summary: The TikTok GO Central Hub MVP provides a dedicated space for local services, enabling users to discover and engage with dining deals and activities.

records.title: Travel Destination
records.feature_overview: This feature introduces a destination-centric travel hub within TikTok, aiming to create an integrated user journey that combines inspirational content with bookable travel products like hotels and attractions.
records.user_flow: Entrance to Attraction POI page, Hotel recommendation, Travel recommendation
records.localization_notes: Please pay attention to variables such as {s_aoi} (Area of Interest, e.g., a city name) and {s_poiRating} (Point of Interest rating). Ensure they are correctly placed within the translated strings. Maintain consistency for common UI elements. For example, the 'View' CTA should be translated uniformly across the feature. The rating format combines a numerical rating with a category. Ensure this structure is respected (e.g., '{s_poiRating} · {s_secondaryCategory}').
records.summary: The Travel Destination feature provides a comprehensive travel planning hub within TikTok, integrating discovery and booking functionalities.

records.title: US/JP Accommodation Shelf Localization
records.feature_overview: This feature enhances the hotel booking experience on TikTok for US and Japanese users by revamping the hotel shelf UI. It aims to build trust and improve conversion by providing clearer, more transparent information, including detailed price breakdowns (per night, taxes), multi-OTA comparisons, and localized selling points.
records.user_flow: OTAs will be displayed in different tabs on the Shelf sub-page.
records.localization_notes: • Maintain a concise and clear tone, especially for button CTAs ( Book now , Go to {s_otaName} ) and labels ( From {s_price} ). • When translating informational content, such as in the 'Price details' panel, ensure the language is simple and direct to avoid ambiguity about pricing policies. • For empty states or error messages (e.g., 'No rooms available'), the tone should be helpful and guide the user to the next step, like viewing similar stays. • For the Japanese linguists, please refer to this Figma file (https://www.figma.com/design/StXhZXMapBHnIzONJEuAMF/TikTok-Japan-market-feature-figma?node-id=312-2&p=f&t=6uo10zvWNvCb7a7n-0) for the Japanese UIs. Other team members can also check the EN figma for the user journey. You need to use the provided Japanese translations, as they're provided by the local team and approved by the JP linguist team.
records.summary: The feature revamps the hotel shelf UI on TikTok to enhance the booking experience for US and Japanese users.

records.title: Indonesia PMK-37 Tax Regulation Compliance
records.feature_overview: To comply with Indonesia's PMK 37/2025 regulation, this feature automates a 0.5% withholding tax for eligible merchants starting May 1, 2026. The Q1 project involves integrating with the tax engine for NPWP validation, calculating withholdings, and issuing WHT slips. It aims to ensure regulatory compliance while providing a clear process for merchants to submit exemption documents and manage their tax obligations on the platform.
records.user_flow: Manage certificate, Tax exemption documents, Statement letter
records.localization_notes: • Non-translatable terms: NPWP, IDR, PMK 37, WHT. Please refer to the context. • Maintain consistent capitalization and punctuation for UI elements as shown in the preview texts. • CTAs should be concise and use an imperative tone (e.g., 'Submit certifications,' 'Manage certifications'). • Ensure accuracy of regulatory terms like 'withholding tax' and 'exemption.' • Follow standard Indonesian formatting for dates and currency (IDR).
records.summary: This feature automates compliance with Indonesia's PMK 37/2025 regulation regarding withholding tax for eligible merchants.

records.title: SMB Self-Service Onboarding Process Construction
records.feature_overview: This feature streamlines the onboarding process for Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMBs) in the Indonesian dining industry. It simplifies qualification requirements and integrates business preparation tasks into a clearer workflow. The goal is to lower onboarding barriers, allowing SMBs (merchants with fewer than 20 POIs) to complete all pre-operation tasks more efficiently.
records.user_flow: 1. Onboarding task 1 -> 2. Onboarding task 2 -> 3. Onboarding task 3 -> 4. Onboarding task 4 -> Finish
records.target_audience: Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMBs) in the Indonesian dining industry
records.localization_notes: • Maintain a professional and encouraging tone to guide new merchants through the onboarding process. • Pay attention to character limits for button labels and titles to avoid UI truncation issues. • Follow standard capitalization rules for titles and labels (e.g., Title Case for buttons). • Ensure consistency with platform-specific terminology, such as 'Nomor Induk Berusaha (NIB)', 'POI', and 'Statement Letter'. • Some strings contain legal or financial terms. Please ensure translations are precise and legally appropriate for the target market (Indonesia).
records.summary: This feature enhances the onboarding experience for SMBs in the Indonesian dining sector by simplifying processes and requirements.

records.title: Version management tool for FAQ management on ByteHi
records.feature_overview: Optimize the Version Management functionality within the ByteHi Knowledge Base Configuration module. Building upon existing Activity Logs, this update adds Content Change Records. Goal: Ensure full traceability of content changes to meet external audit and legal compliance requirements.
records.user_flow: Users can view and restore historical snapshots from any point in time.
records.content_type: Headers, tabs, buttons, popup titles, body text and buttons, metadata fields, and toast messages
records.localization_notes: Please make sure you fully understand the user flow before translating so the content is coherent and natural. Please keep your translation clear and concise. For internal or technical terms you're not familiar with, feel free to raise a query for clarification.
records.summary: The feature enhances version management in ByteHi's Knowledge Base by adding content change records for better traceability.

records.title: AI Remix
records.feature_overview: AI Remix is a feature within Camera that lets you recreate and remix videos with prompt.
records.user_flow: Entrance -> Voice Input prompt
records.localization_notes: Language style should be clear and conversational, resonating with TikTok's creators.
records.summary: AI Remix allows users to recreate and remix videos using voice prompts.

records.title: Cast
records.feature_overview: Cast is a feature that supports users to generate short videos with prompt, remix videos by mentioning their own or others’ ID avatars (AI Self ID). Users need to set up their AI Self ID to use this feature.
records.user_flow: Entrance -> Input prompt -> Co-star @ more people -> Recreation and @ other to co-star complete -> Record AI Self ID -> Edit profile -> Record oneself -> Recording ID generation -> ID management -> Cast tab on user profile -> Cast tab -> Uncast post -> Cast tab (with Permission management post)
records.content_type: Title, CTA button, tab, description, prompt, inbox notif
records.localization_notes: Some languages have benchmarked OpenAI's Sora (a similar product to TikTok's Cast feature) to get insights into terminology and style. KO: Sora 2 Benchmarking Korean TH: Sora 2 Benchmarking Thai VI: Sora 2 Benchmarking Vietnamese ES-LATAM: Sora 2 Benchmarking_Spanish-Latam
records.summary: The Cast feature allows users to create and remix short videos using AI Self IDs.

records.title: CSI AI Planner & homepage icon texts
records.feature_overview: The AI Planner is a coaching system in Creator Search Insight (CSI) for TikTok creators. It helps them set goals, establish a content rhythm, and receive daily actionable suggestions over 21-day cycles. By connecting goals, rhythm, content, and feedback, it guides creators toward sustainable growth and builds long-term trust with the platform.
records.user_flow: AI planner user journey through CSI homepage and its affiliate pages.
records.localization_notes: • Maintain an encouraging, creative, and user-friendly tone, as this feature acts as a 'personal coach.' • Ensure key terms are consistent: 'AI Planner,' 'Creator Search Insight,' 'cycle.' • CTAs should be clear and concise (e.g., 'Create plan,' 'View plan,' 'Update my details'). • When localizing placeholder text in input fields (e.g., 'I’d like tips on...'), ensure the translation serves as a clear example for the user. • Pay attention to pluralization for terms like 'suggestion' vs. 'suggestions' to match the context accurately. • Please refer to the character limit requirement for strings with the 'CSI_icon_text' tag.
records.summary: The AI Planner assists TikTok creators in setting goals and receiving actionable content suggestions to foster sustainable growth.

records.title: AI Canvas Module
records.feature_overview: AI Canvas helps TikTok Search creators turn decision-making topics into informative photo-text posts. From the CSI details page, creators open the AI Canvas entry, keep or edit the topic, upload up to eight photos, and add a description. AI generates a structured draft that can be reviewed and edited before applying text onto the photos and producing final images, with supporting pages for education, loading states, and publishing.
records.user_flow: Creators open AI Canvas, edit topic, upload photos, add description, review AI-generated draft, apply text, produce final images.
records.content_type: Title & Desc, Button, CTA, Link, Placeholder, Uploader, Loading State
records.localization_notes: • Tone of Voice: Maintain an encouraging, creative, and user-friendly tone. The language should feel helpful and inspiring, not overly technical. • Terminology: Keep key terms consistent. 'AI Canvas' is the feature name; preserve capitalization of 'AI' and product names. • Action Text: Use concise, imperative commands for CTAs such as 'View example' and 'Add photo'. • Constraints & Numbers: Keep limits exact (e.g., 'up to 8 photos', '60 secs'); do not change numerical values. • Loading Messages: For strings like 'Analyzing your idea...' or 'Almost there...', keep the progressive aspect and ellipsis pattern consistent and natural. Please use transcreation for loading messages. • Clarity of Ideas: Clearly distinguish between 'idea', 'content', and 'layout' to avoid ambiguity in target languages.
records.summary: The AI Canvas Module enables creators to transform decision-making topics into engaging photo-text posts with AI assistance.

records.title: Story Reveal
records.feature_overview: This feature aims to introduce a new form of interactive story publishing and a new format of story (with the dual camera). It allows users to post stories that can only be viewed after posting, encouraging social interaction and daily posting habits.
records.user_flow: 1. Creation: New flip camera format, post hidden story, receive daily push to post with friends at the same time. 2. Consumption: Post to unlock all story reveals (for 24 hours).
records.localization_notes: Keep the feature name short and concise. Make it engaging to users.
records.summary: The Story Reveal feature introduces an interactive story format that requires users to post to view, enhancing social connections and encouraging daily engagement.

records.title: P00 Artist Campaign
records.feature_overview: Confidentiality is quite important for this artist, so if there's a way, plz keep this project to limited people only!
records.localization_notes: We suggest that you work with the keys starting with "p00" altogether in order to ensure the term and tone consistency although they are in 3 projects. This is a critical campaign. Please avoid literal translations.
records.summary: This feature focuses on a confidential artist campaign requiring limited access.

records.title: TTLS Sales Earning Pending
records.feature_overview: Sellers earn money from their shops, known as Sales Earnings, which are divided into Available Balance and Estimated Pending Balance to provide clarity and flexibility in purchasing collaboration creator packages.
records.user_flow: Sellers can use both Available Balance and Estimated Pending Balance to purchase collaboration creator packages, allowing immediate activation of orders.
records.localization_notes: • Keep balance names consistent: “Available Balance” and “Estimated Pending Balance. • Keep neighboring texts in consistent form. e.g. From available balance; From est. pending balance
records.summary: The feature allows sellers to use both confirmed and unverified earnings to purchase collaboration packages.

records.title: VOC (Voice of Customer) Platform
records.feature_overview: A user feedback analysis and follow-up platform built by the experience operations team for the internal TikTok community, dedicated to helping businesses optimize product and service experiences through productization.
records.localization_notes: This platform will be used by internal TikTok teams only and should not be adapted as customer-facing content. The platform currently supports en and zh-Hans only.
records.summary: The VOC platform enables managers to see key business issues clearly from overall to the local level.

records.title: Cash Advance new landing page (MY, VN, TH, ID only)
records.feature_overview: We're launching Cash Advance's new landing page on TT Shop Seller Center (webapp)
records.localization_notes: Ensure "incomplete strings" is cohesively translated in the context. e.g. "after 5am the next day" is placed after title "Get settlements". Title (slogan) should be clear and catchy. e.g. Ship today, get paid tomorrow
records.summary: The feature introduces a new landing page for Cash Advance on the TT Shop Seller Center.

records.title: Text mode adds AI-generated templates
records.feature_overview: We'll add AI templates to Text mode, which allows creators to apply custom templates that match the text they entered.
records.user_flow: In-app tutorial, System notif
records.localization_notes: Ensure in-app tutorial is clear and engaging, prompting users to try the AI template in Text mode. Title and desc should be coherent.
records.summary: The feature introduces AI-generated templates in Text mode for creators.

records.title: Editor Pro AI Create supports third-party models
records.feature_overview: Editor Pro AI Create is an AI-powered video/image generation feature that allows creators to generate high quality visual content using a text prompt.
records.user_flow: Create video: [steps not provided]; Create image: [steps not provided]
records.localization_notes: Keep the mode names clear and concise; Ensure the translation of desc aligns with the mode, e.g. Mode: High quality; Desc: Cinematic and detailed, supports multi-shots and audio.
records.summary: Editor Pro AI Create enables creators to generate high quality visual content through AI using text prompts.

records.title: AIGE Web 1.0
records.feature_overview: We will launch AIGE Web: A light-weight webpage that enables users to create effects via chat and preview the results instantly—without the need to download anything. AIGE Web can be assessed from Effect House website.
records.user_flow: Landing page → Input prompt → Preview effect
records.localization_notes: Keep "AIGE" as DNT (it's a brand name and well recognized in the context of AI or digital effect). Keep "/prompt" as DNT.
records.summary: AIGE Web allows users to create and preview effects through a lightweight webpage without downloads.

records.title: Editor Pro AI Create supports prompt rewrite and third-party models
records.feature_overview: Feature iteration for AI Create (an AI-powered video/image generation tool within Editor Pro). AI Create now supports 10-second shorts with multiple clips, narrative structure, and audio. To achieve this, we integrated third-party models and upgraded our internal models.
records.localization_notes:
• Translate according to where the text will display
• e.g. Tab name or label should be concise
• Ensure neighbouring texts use the same form
• e.g. Create video, Create image
records.summary: AI Create now supports enhanced video/image generation features with third-party model integration.

records.title: Creator DM - Reply assistant promotion
records.feature_overview: AI Smart Replies is to build an AI chatbot for TikTok creators to reply to direct messages efficiently and boost user engagement.
records.user_flow: Onboarding -> Setup Topics -> Opt-in/Opt-out -> Check online conversation and recalibrate
records.localization_notes: It's a GTM campaign. Pay more attention to translation reliability.
records.summary: The feature provides an AI chatbot to assist TikTok creators in managing direct message replies.

records.title: AI Imagine - prompts
records.feature_overview: Add more preset style and prompt. When users upload a picture to AI Imagine, they can select a preset style and use default prompt to refine their picture.
records.localization_notes: Prompt should align TT's voices. e.g. conversational and approachable. Don't sound like we're instructing users.
records.summary: AI Imagine allows users to enhance their images by selecting preset styles and prompts.

records.title: AME AIGC Model - presets and prompts
records.feature_overview: We're adding presets and prompts to AIGC models (Image Alive, Keyframe Morph, Stylization, and Portrait)
records.user_flow: Go to AI Model (effect type), e.g. AI Alive > Select a preset, use prompt > generate pic
records.content_type: Preset names, e.g. Kiss, hug, werewolf, dark magic; Prompt
records.localization_notes: Keep preset name clear and concise; Refer to this doc to have a visual understanding of what the presets does
records.summary: This feature introduces presets and prompts for AIGC models to enhance user creativity.

records.title: TikTok GO LIVE Console (for id-ID/zh-Hans)
records.feature_overview: We've already translated the UI content for LIVE audiences and hosts. We will start to localize a standalone website—TikTok GO LIVE Console—that creators and their assistants can use to manage relevant matters for a LIVE session, including adding vouchers, starting/pausing/ending a LIVE session, chatting with LIVE audiences, managing LIVE comments, monitoring data in real-time, etc.
records.user_flow: Account login page -> Welcome page -> Log in page -> LIVE flow 1 -> LIVE flow 2 -> Product management 1 -> Product management 2 -> Pin a voucher/product
records.target_audience: Creators or their assistants who will manage relevant matters for a LIVE session
records.localization_notes: I recommend linguists to refer to LIVE team's Starling projects for relevant translations. The following two are the major LIVE Starling projects: live_client, TikTok_LIVE_FE. Please help refer to the LIVE-related glossary wherever it is applicable. For the following two keys, please note that the team separates them into two lines, but they should be a single sentence: ttlsLIVE_consoleLogInPage_title1, ttlsLIVE_consoleLogInPage_title2. TikTok GO LIVE Console is the product name of the standalone website for creators or their assistants. We should translate it as 'TikTok GO 直播中控台' in Chinese; for Indonesian, please also ensure the translation consistency of 'Console'. Pin is a function that a host can use to pin a product card to the LIVE session when he/she explains it to the LIVE audiences. In this scenario, the translation of pin should be closer to 'showcasing'. For example, it's translated as '讲解' in Chinese. However, in the LIVE chat scenario, the translation of 'pin' should be translated as 'move to top' in translations. As we have both of these two scenarios in the TTLS LIVE content. So please pay attention to it when translating/reviewing. For 'Pin to showcase (ttlsLIVE_consoleLandingPage_liveStarted_vouchersSection_voucherCard_pinHoverDesc)', we might translate it as '开始讲解'.
records.summary: The TikTok GO LIVE Console is a localized web UI for creators and their assistants to manage LIVE sessions effectively.

records.title: AI Imagine
records.feature_overview: AI Imagine is a feature that is very similar to a chatbot you can talk to for image generation, image editing, and image styling. You can create images from text, edit existing photos (e.g retouch, enhance colors), or apply styles to existing photos (e.g anime, retro, vintage).
records.user_flow: H5: tells users how to use AI Imagine; UI (previously Visual Poet, now AI Imagine)
records.localization_notes: See above.
records.summary: AI Imagine allows users to generate and edit images through a conversational interface.

records.title: Wicked for good
records.feature_overview: This H5 campaign for the release of Wicked: For Good will be one of TikTok's tentpole activities of the year, supporting NBC Universal on the Film/TV side while also driving music engagement through Universal Music Group.
records.user_flow: 1. Complete challenges to get profile frames. 2. Tracklist. 3. DM (Direct message).
records.content_type: h5 campaign: title, desc, button; FYP: anchor, banner
records.localization_notes: Please follow the internal/official translations for profile names. e.g, Emerald City, Broom & Wand, Glinda's Crown, Elphaba's Hat, TBD. Es, es-latam, fr, pt, pt-br, de, it should refer to [Wicked: for good] Profile name translations. Use transcreations to spark users' interests in participating in the campaign and get rewards. e.g. It's not easy being green, but it's powerful. Post a video with "{s_trackName}" and the hashtag #WickedForGood, and hit 100 views. Hashtags and movie names should be kept in English. Keep the translation clear and concise. Title should be under 16, desc under 47. We noticed some English descriptions seem overly long. Pls wait for further notice on the exact length limit.
records.summary: The Wicked for Good campaign promotes the film through user engagement challenges and profile customization.

records.title: AME AIGC AI model
records.feature_overview: Supports effects creators in generating Image-to-Video AIGC special effects by rewriting prompts.
records.user_flow: Writing prompt to generate.
records.localization_notes: Keep AI model names clear, consistent and adhere to industry standards. Follow the length restrictions of button text.
records.summary: This feature enables effects creators to generate special effects using AI by rewriting prompts.

records.title: EoY (end-of-year) recap campaign
records.feature_overview: Add event entries to CREATE tab, For your page (FYP), inbox page to help users easily discover the annual recap activity, fulfilling their desire to create memories and reflect at the end of year.
records.user_flow: Entry point: CREATE tab FYP anchor Camera Inbox Profile banner. After entry: user can choose to generate their 2025 recap post auto-generate recap user-generate recap when there is no access to album.
records.localization_notes: Ensure "recap" is translated consistently in all scenarios. Recap should ideally be under 8 characters. Language style should be positive and engaging.
records.summary: The feature allows users to create and share their end-of-year recap posts easily.

records.title: LIVE Host's user journey (for id-ID/zh-Hans/en-GB)
records.feature_overview: Before the end of 2025, the local services team aims to launch LIVE functionality for the dining industry on the Indonesian market, supporting TTLS creators to add products for sales and perform business operations during their LIVE streamings.
records.user_flow: Pre-LIVE: Add vouchers, Voucher list; During LIVE: Perform business operations.
records.localization_notes: I recommend linguists to refer to LIVE team's Starling projects for relevant translations (for example, the button of 'Pin', and the entrance UI of 'Business'). The following two are the major ones: live_client, TikTok_LIVE_FE. Please help refer to the LIVE-related glossary wherever it is applicable.
records.summary: The feature enables TTLS creators to manage product sales and business operations during their LIVE streams in the Indonesian market.

records.title: LIVE C-end User Flow MVP (for id-ID/zh-Hans/en-GB)
records.feature_overview: Before the end of 2025, the local services team aims to launch LIVE functionality for the dining industry on the Indonesian market, focusing on basic functions and transaction capabilities of the LIVE room.
records.user_flow: The user can watch live and click the product card to check the product shelf or enter a specific product detail page, purchase food & beverage vouchers, and redeem them at an outlet.
records.target_audience: Logged in users whose age is 18+ and currently lives in Indonesia.
records.localization_notes: When translating general words like item and shelf, please bear in mind that the context is for the TTLS dining shelf or product card in TTLS dining LIVE. I recommend linguists to refer to LIVE team's Starling projects for relevant translations: live_client, TikTok_LIVE_FE.
records.summary: This feature enables Indonesian users to engage with LIVE dining experiences by purchasing and redeeming food and beverage vouchers.

records.title: Well-being missions V2
records.feature_overview: TikTok's well-being missions are a series of short, engaging missions designed to help people develop long-term balanced digital habits, encouraging mindful behaviors through gamified challenges.
records.user_flow: 1. Complete a breathing exercise each week for Sleep hours streak. 2. Set and stick to daily time limit. 3. Explore revamped screen time dashboard. 4. Share missions as a Well-being ambassador.
records.localization_notes: Please be sure to translate weekday abbreviations (MON, SUN, THU, etc) to the abbreviated format in your language.
records.summary: The feature introduces gamified well-being missions to promote balanced digital habits among users.

records.title: Taylor Swift Campaign Phase II: Official launch
records.feature_overview: We are building a two-phase campaign for Taylor Swift's 12th studio album, The Life of a Showgirl, launching on 3rd October.
records.user_flow: 1. Find your inner song from the new album (which song best represents you) 2. Reveal your journey of being a Swiftie on TikTok 3. Share your journey card through chat
records.localization_notes: • Keep artists and album names as DNT • Keep the translation concise to avoid clutter on H5 • Adopt transcreation when necessary to convey the essence of the source. Avoid being too literal • Voice of tones should be clear, conversational and engaging.
records.summary: This feature is the official launch campaign for Taylor Swift's album, encouraging user engagement through personalized tasks.

records.title: Organization Monetization
records.feature_overview: In support of serving contracted external developers/vendors on TikTok Open Platform at scale, we are productizing the entire fund settlement flow so that developers/vendors can self-serve through the entire fund management journey instead of relying on handholding provided by Ops representatives.
records.user_flow: Monetization enablement, Revenue settlement, Sign legal documents & enter business details, Invoice & payout
records.target_audience: Third-party developers/vendor who manage their mini app monetization through TikTok for Developers platform (https://developers.tiktok.com/)
records.localization_notes: Ensure clarity and accuracy of technical terms; Raise a query if you're not sure
records.summary: The feature enables third-party developers to self-manage their monetization processes on the TikTok Open Platform.

records.title: Taylor Swift Campaign Phase I: Presave
records.feature_overview: Taylor Swift has officially announced her 12th studio album, The Life of a Showgirl, launching on 3rd October. This is one of the most significant music moments of 2025 and an unmatched opportunity for TikTok to position itself as the epicenter of fan excitement, music discovery, and cultural conversation. We are building a two-phase campaign: Phase 1 focuses on teasing the album and driving pre-saves across Spotify and Apple Music, while generating sustained engagement with new gameplay mechanics.
records.user_flow: 1. Follow Taylor Swift 2. Presave Album 3. Join TaylorNation 4. Engage with Mystic Door Gameplay revealed after browsing profile frames.
records.localization_notes: Keep artists and album names as DNT. Ensure banner and title text are concise to prevent truncation, such as 'Ablum out', 'Unlock in', 'Get notified'. Adopt transcreation for descriptive texts such as 'Knock knock… wait till you see what comes through the door!'
records.summary: The feature promotes Taylor Swift's album pre-save campaign on TikTok, enhancing user engagement through gameplay mechanics.

records.title: In-App Ads(IAAs) sandbox
records.feature_overview: Enable developers to add IAA ad placement in the sandbox environment and run through the IAA functionality in the sandbox environment.
records.user_flow: Developers can add ad placements in the sandbox environment and debug the IAA functionality.
records.target_audience: Developers who add and test their mini apps at TikTok for Developers platform (https://developers.tiktok.com/)
records.localization_notes: Make sure you translate technical/industrial terms like IAA(In-App Ad) or IAP(In-App Purchase) correctly. Do your own research when translating some 'technical' content. Raise a query if you don't understand something.
records.summary: This feature allows developers to integrate and test In-App Ads within a sandbox environment.

records.title: Native Runtime
records.feature_overview: "Native Runtime" is a program to support the continued global growth of lightweight applications such as mini games on TikTok. This initiative aims to build a self-developed, TikTok-led native runtime environment that will serve TikTok's future mini game ecosystem.
records.user_flow: Create an App, Add test users, Create a sandbox, Upload mini game code assets
records.target_audience: Developers who add and test their mini apps at TikTok for Developers platform (https://developers.tiktok.com/)
records.localization_notes: Ensure clarity and accuracy of technical terms; Raise a query if you're not sure
records.summary: The Native Runtime feature enables developers to create, debug, and publish mini games on TikTok.

records.title: B-end Support Merchants Use Rebate (ID, zh-Hans only)
records.feature_overview: We're introducing a Rebate feature on the merchant platform to allow merchants to get rebates from merchant commissions earned through successful transactions on the platform.
records.user_flow: Clicking Confirm will bring them to the Rebate details page. Once confirmed, settlement will be moved to the 'Settlement details' tab. Merchants can also export their rebate history.
records.content_type: Data tables, charts, buttons, modals, tooltips, desktop/web UI
records.summary: The feature allows merchants to receive rebates from commissions earned through successful transactions.
records._note: localization_notes removed (bled in from next feature 'Creator Marketplace for Agency (ID, JV, JP only)')

records.title: Creator Marketplace for Agency (ID, JV, JP only)
records.feature_overview: Creator Marketplace for Agency is a feature within the TikTok GO for Agencies platform, designed to help creator agencies discover and recruit qualified TikTok GO creators.

datasets.title: Netflix Theatrical — Operating Procedures (Linguistic)
datasets.source_file: [Netflix- Theatrical] Operating Procedures for Resources - Linguistic.pdf

records.title: Overview & Services
records.summary: Wordbank localizes Netflix theatrical trailers/artwork; linguists do subtitling, on-screen text, artwork translation, and LQA2.
records.content: Since 2022 Wordbank localizes Netflix theatrical marketing (AV + Print/Digital) for limited theatrical/awards runs. Linguist services: (1) AV Trailer Localization — subtitle translation in Nikse Subtitle Edit, delivered as an SRT (full theatrical, teaser, cutdown); (2) Dialogue Linguistic Review (Dubs) — review translated actor dialogue vs the English SRT source, using frame.io; (3) On-Screen Text — localize on-screen text and suggest forced narratives via provided Google Sheets; (4) Marketing Assets — Key Artwork (print) and digital banners via Google Sheets; (5) Quality Assurance (LQA2) — mid-process and final in-country QA. A given project may include all of these content types or just one or two — proceed based on which files are provided.
records.notes: Goal each trailer: match the look, feel and 'creative intent' of the original.

records.title: Allocation & Jira Tickets
records.summary: Work is assigned via Jira tickets; set up notifications and read project-specific notes at the top of the ticket.
records.content: You are assigned tickets in Jira; ensure notifications are on. Use the Theatrical Jira Training Deck to learn the interface. Jira is where you find: due/delivery dates, CTA and asset info, collaborators, next steps/ticket transitions, and tickets assigned to you. Any project-specific notes appear at the top of your Jira ticket or in a static doc in your AV language folder (no more trailer-to-trailer briefs this year).

records.title: Project Deadlines
records.summary: 0.5-day (24h) turnaround per task; request extensions or reassignment from the Project Coordinator on the ticket.
records.content: On assignment you have a 0.5-day window to complete a task; the exact submission date/time is confirmed by the Production Coordinator at kick-off. If you need an extension, contact the Project Coordinator listed on the ticket with a clear reason for the delay, or state your preference to have the task reassigned.

records.title: General Instructions & Shared-Server Rules
records.summary: Work only in your language folder, never delete master files, version by copy-and-rename, and don't touch software logins/security settings.
records.content: Before starting, read all instructions and reference material (subtitle guidelines CHANGED from last year). You work on Wordbank servers (installation/login instructions came from ITS). IMPORTANT: (1) work only within your assigned language folders in the shared master folder; (2) never delete content, especially master files — others may depend on footage, .srt's, project files, reviews, finals; (3) to change an already-delivered file, make a COPY and save it as a new version, then notify via the Jira ticket. Versioning example: BRDO_Experience30_FR_v1.prproj → _v2.prproj. (4) Do not edit logins, security settings, phone numbers or MFA on server software/plug-ins even if prompted — contact the team if it blocks you.

records.title: Reference Materials (Netflix Guidelines)
records.summary: Follow the Netflix Subtitle & Bug Guidelines, Language Style Guides, and your language's Timed Text Style Guide before any task.
records.content: Before beginning any task, review all Netflix reference materials (they may have changed since last year): (1) Netflix Subtitle & Bug Guidelines; (2) Language Style Guides; (3) Timed Text Style Guides — find your language in the list and follow it (numbers, dialogue, italics, CPL/CPS, forced-narrative rules, etc.). Note: subtitle guidelines changed from last year.
records.notes: The Timed Text Style Guide is the authoritative source for CPL/CPS limits per language.

records.title: TEP & LQA2 — Task Summary
records.summary: TEP = create the localized .srt in Subtitle Edit + localize OST/FN in the Google Sheet; LQA2 = in-format review of the finished trailer, flagged via frame.io.
records.content: Summary of the two Linguistic AV tasks. TEP (Translation, Editing, Proofreading): create a localized .srt within Nikse Subtitle Edit from the provided source script or .srt, AND localize On-Screen Text and forced narratives in the Google Sheet linked on the Jira ticket. LQA2 (Linguistic Quality Assurance 2): perform an in-format review of the localized trailers AFTER the Video Editors create them; flag any required updates via the provided frame.io link per asset, in the specified format, for review by the PM and Video Editors. During LQA2 do NOT generate a supplemental .srt or modify the Google Sheet.

records.title: TEP Setup — Subtitle Edit & Files Provided
records.summary: Set Subtitle Edit to your language's Netflix presets; the PC provides EN SRT, Text Doc.xlsx, trailer URL, EN frame.io reference, and the localized CTA.
records.content: Before translating, download Subtitle Edit and set all configs to the Netflix Subtitle pre-sets (see the 'SUBTITLE EDIT - How to' doc; set the correct built-in Netflix subtitle presets for your language). Japanese/Korean: Wordbank should provide a PDF preset config to import — if missing, contact the PM immediately. The Production Coordinator provides in the Jira ticket: (1) English SRT file; (2) Text Doc.xlsx; (3) URL to the English trailer; (4) EN Reference Trailer frame.io link; (5) Localized CTA (theatrical release date) — pre-approved by Netflix, do not change unless there's an error. Pre-work steps: watch the English trailer and review the script/.srt; download the EN SRT and open the linked Text Doc (GFX) sheet; import the EN .srt and open the Subtitle Edit URL from the Jira ticket into Subtitle Edit.

records.title: TEP — Subtitle Translation Rules
records.summary: Deliver an accurately timed/formatted SRT; keep cues short within CPL/CPS; prefer creative interpretation over literal; you may have no spotting list.
records.content: Translate, edit and proofread the dialogue/subtitles and deliver an accurately timed and formatted .SRT following standard subtitling practice for your language. Refer to your language-specific Timed Text Style Guidelines for numbers, dialogue, italics, and CPL/CPS. Keep subtitles short and within character limits while still reflecting the feeling of the source. Creative interpretation is preferred to literal translation: you may truncate (e.g. 'It's so nice to see you' → 'Nice to see you') and interpret slang by intent (e.g. Nimona's 'Metal…' before a fight means 'hardcore/brutal', not the literal metal). No spotting list is provided — you may need to work without a reference SRT; an English script is provided when possible.

records.title: TEP — On-Screen Text: Graphic Cards (GFX)
records.summary: Translate GFX (designed/animated on-screen text) in the linked Google Sheet; add color/position/italics/size to the Notes row; skip cards Netflix already localized.
records.content: On-Screen Text is localized in the Text Doc (Google Sheet) linked under the Web-Links section of the Jira ticket. Graphic Cards (GFX): on-screen text that has a design or animation; your translations are handed to the video editors to apply the effects. If a localized word/phrase should be a certain color, position, italics, or size to match the source, add that to the 'Notes' row in the sheet. Sometimes Netflix provides the localized GFX cards — you may see them in the source trailer but find no space for them on the Google Sheet; you do not need to translate those.

records.title: TEP — On-Screen Text: Forced Narrative (FN)
records.summary: FN is plot-pertinent on-screen text (e.g. a newspaper 'FUGITIVE WANTED') translated in the same Google Sheet as GFX; review-quotes now show as graphics — add formatting notes.
records.content: Forced Narrative (FN) is on-screen text that must be localized because it is pertinent to the plot; it is separate from subtitles and Graphic Card text (e.g. a newspaper reading 'FUGITIVE WANTED'). Review quotes from publications: Netflix has moved away from using 'Forced Narrative' for review quotes — these now show as graphics, so add notes on formatting (color, font, size, sentence case, etc.). More FN guidelines per language are in the Timed Text Style Guides. Translate all FN text in the SAME Google Sheet that contains the GFX card text (linked in the Description section at the top of the Jira ticket). Example: the translation of 'Ruthless' (from a critic's review) appears on screen in black/white capitals. FNs usually appear at the bottom of the screen but may move to the top if they overlap subtitles.

records.title: TEP — Call To Action (CTA) Rules
records.summary: Netflix provides CTA translations — do NOT translate unless the PM asks; disregard the source CTA; the correct CTA is in the Jira description.
records.content: Call To Action (CTA): Netflix provides CTA translations — DO NOT translate unless specifically requested by the PM. In 2025 CTAs include Month and Date, e.g. 'In Select Theaters December 19'. Disregard the CTA in the source trailer (source may include a date + 'And on Netflix' — not needed for Theatrical). The correct CTA translation is in the Jira description box. PRE CTA = the film's release date, e.g. 'IN SELECT THEATERS JANUARY 5'. POST CTA tells viewers it's now watchable, e.g. 'NOW PLAYING IN SELECT THEATERS'. Dates/formats are localized and pre-approved by Netflix — do not change unless incorrect. Spanish example for 'In Select Theaters October 23'.

records.title: Film Festival Names — Do Not Translate
records.summary: Well-known global festivals/organizations stay in the original language (Venice, Toronto International, Sundance Film Festival).
records.content: 'Film Festival Florals': well-known global organizations/entities should NOT be translated and are kept in the original language, e.g. Venice Film Festival, Toronto International Film Festival, Sundance Film Festival.

records.title: TEP Delivery Checklist & File Naming
records.summary: Proof the SRT and sheet, fix CPS/CPL flags, export the SRT named with version + language code, upload to the Jira parent ticket, then transition TEP → VE and tag the editor.
records.content: Once TEP is done: (1) check the .srt is free from objective linguistic errors (spelling, grammar); (2) ensure all GFX/FN text is translated completely and error-free; (3) ensure formatting notes are relevant and complete (color/size/bold/italics to match source); (4) fix any CPS/CPL errors flagged by Subtitle Edit as best as possible (short assets mean it won't always be possible); (5) export the localized SRT from Subtitle Edit including the version number and language code in the filename, e.g. IT_KOWUD_CONFESSIONS_30_CUTDOWN; (6) upload the translated .srt (drag and drop) into the attachments section of the Jira PARENT ticket; (7) add your translations to the linked Google Sheet and leave it as is; (8) transition the parent ticket from TEP to VE and, in a comment, @-tag the assigned VE: 'TEP/translation is complete and ready for VE.'
records.notes: STOP after TEP — LQA2 happens only after the Video Editors build the localized trailer.

records.title: LQA2 — Scope & What to Check
records.summary: Review every localized format (16x9, 9x16, 4x5, 1x1 SUB/DUB) in the Smart Checklist against the English source: subtitles, GFX, FN, CTA, and dubbing.
records.content: LQA2 starts AFTER the Video Editors edit the trailer with subtitles, GFX, and CTA; you are re-tagged in the Jira ticket. Review ALL localized aspect ratios/formats (16x9, 9x16, 4x5, 1x1 SUB and/or DUB) listed in the Smart Checklist to ensure they are translation-error-free and that audio/graphic effects match the EN trailer. Cross-reference the localized .srt (in attachments) and the GFX Text Doc (weblinks) against the English source. Check per file: (a) Subtitles — displayed properly per Netflix guidelines, no objective linguistic errors, no overlap/early cut-off/timing/formatting errors; (b) Graphic Cards — localized properly, no linguistic errors, match source color/position/formatting/animation/size (for Netflix-provided GFX only call out objective errors); (c) Forced Narrative — localized properly, no linguistic errors, no overlap/conflict with GFX or subtitles, timed correctly (usually review quotes); (d) CTA — localized and correct vs the Jira Description box; (e) Dubbing — matches the actor's speech/subtitles; dubs were recorded by a different vendor and cannot be changed, so accept as-is but flag major objective issues: cut-off audio, mismatched audio, anything overtly offensive.
records.notes: If errors are found, create an OQA report. DO NOT create a v2 .srt or edit the Google Sheet — they won't be referenced.

records.title: LQA2 — Flagging Format & Delivery (Pass/Fail)
records.summary: Flag errors in frame.io at the timestamp as 'Please change XX to XX', set each format Pass/Fail, then transition the ticket and tag the right person.
records.content: Deliver LQA2 depending on pass/fail. FAIL: do NOT create a new .srt or edit the Google Sheet. In the comment section to the right of the trailer screen, add comments AT THE TIMESTAMP where the error appears using the exact format: 'Please change XX to XX' (this clear, direct format is required so editors can act; unclear comments get sent back). After watching all Smart-Checklist formats, use the 'In Progress' drop-down per format to mark passed/failed LQA2; change the main Jira drop-down from LQA2 to VE; @-tag the assigned Video Editor noting which assets failed. PASS: mark Pass per asset; change the main drop-down from LQA2 to Tech QA; comment 'All assets passed LQA2, Ready for QA.' When done, add any notes and tag the Production Coordinator.
records.notes: Same flag format is used for artwork: 'Change XXX to XXX'.

records.title: LQA2 for Recycled Content
records.summary: Recycled (producer-localized, pre-QCed) content: pass as-is, flag only major objective issues, make no preferential changes.
records.content: 'Recycled content' is material Netflix's producer already localized and pre-QCed. Wordbank committed to one QC round: in most cases pass as-is, but flag major objective issues only — incorrect line break, misspelling, missing subtitle, audio/video sync issues, cut-off audio, anything overtly offensive in the dub. Some material may already be in market, so you must NOT make preferential changes or suggestions to the translations.

records.title: Artwork — Translation Task
records.summary: Artwork tickets (turquoise camera icon) provide a 2-column EN/blank table; translate the right column, then transition to Artwork Design and tag the Designer.
records.content: Artwork tickets are marked in Jira with a turquoise camera icon and titled by artwork type (Key Art, Teaser, Vertical, Horizontal, Quad). You translate taglines/text (often just a handful of words) for posters, digital banners, ticket buttons, etc. The PC tags you in a comment and provides a 2-column table (EN text left, blank column right). Steps: (1) copy the table; (2) paste it in a comment; (3) enter your translation in the right column; (4) transition the Jira ticket to Artwork Design and tag the assigned Designer that the asset is 'ready for design.'

records.title: Artwork — In-Format Review (LQA2)
records.summary: Check localized art for missing text, mistranslations, incorrect line-breaks, and name inconsistencies; flag as 'Change XXX to XXX' or comment 'LQA2 Pass'.
records.content: For artwork LQA2 the PC tags you to check the translated text on the art. Check for: missing text, mistranslations, incorrect line-breaks, and inconsistencies for any actor/organization names. If errors: in a comment add all errors using 'Change XXX to XXX', transition the ticket back to Artwork Design, and tag the assigned Designer to 'please see errors flagged'. (Jira won't let you tag a non-assignee, so transition first.) If no errors: comment 'LQA2 Pass' and transition to 'Ready for VanDam Upload.'

records.title: Rates — AV Trailer Assets
records.summary: Flat fee per asset: Main Full $85/$65/$25, :30 $17/$13/$10, :15 $15/$10/$10, Teaser $34/$26/$10 (translation / QA / in-format QA).
records.content: Payment is a flat rate per asset completed to standard (USD or equivalent). Reference service rates: ~$0.15/word translation, $10/min subtitling, $0.10/word QA. AV Asset flat rates (Subtitle translation / Subtitle QA / Subtitle in-format QA): Trailer Main Full (~400 words + 2.5 min) = $85 / $65 / $25; Main :30 (~80 words + 0.5 min) = $17 / $13 / $10; Main :15 (~40 words + 0.25 min) = $15 / $10 / $10; Teaser (~160 words + 1 min) = $34 / $26 / $10.
records.notes: The recruiting email quoted different flat fees (e.g. TEP Teaser $60; QA Full Trailer $25) — confirm the applicable rate card with the PM per project.

records.title: Rates — Digital & Artwork; POs & Invoicing
records.summary: Digital banners and artwork (<25 words): $15 translation / $10 in-format QA; POs raised the last Tuesday monthly; invoices via WordXtra.
records.content: Digital Assets (Banner 300x250 / 300x600 / 970x250, all <25 words): Translation $15, In-Format QA $10. Artwork Assets (Key Art Main Vertical/Horizontal, Teaser Vertical/Horizontal, Quad, all <25 words): Translation $15, In-Format QA $10. Flat-rate structure may change but not without prior discussion. Purchase Orders are raised by Preproduction on the last Tuesday of every month. See 'Invoicing and Payment Procedures.docx'.

records.title: Tech & Systems
records.summary: Jira (tickets), WordXtra (invoices, wordxtra.net), Nikse Subtitle Edit (TEP .srt), frame.io (LQA2 annotations), Google Sheets (GFX translations).
records.content: Systems used: JIRA — asset management / ticket allocation (unique login and filters; added per project). WORDXTRA (www.wordxtra.net) — online tool where resources submit and download invoices. NIKSE SUBTITLE EDIT — used to create/edit/proofread the .srt in the TEP step. FRAME.IO — cloud collaboration for frame-accurate annotations on the video timeline; used in the LQA2 step (integrates with Premiere Pro / Final Cut Pro).
